mentions.name: Multicast Bitcoin Transaction Distribution System
mentions.description: A high-throughput multicast Bitcoin transaction distribution system built for BSV Blockchain (also adaptable to other Bitcoin variants), targeting a roadmap towards billions of transactions per second. It provides a control channel for block header announcements, operational mechanisms, and network topology automation; separate channels for subtree, subtree grouping, and transaction load; transaction load sharding by deterministic multicast group membership based on TXID; transaction filtering and retransmission (unicast and multicast) so edge networks interested in only a portion of the load can connect; NACK-based retransmission of missed packets via hash chain gap sequence tracking (per sender, per shard) with automated caching endpoint beacon discovery and tiered network distribution; and BGP-AnyCast based transaction ingress. The topology is dense at the core with layered, sharded group distribution towards users at the edges; site or org-scope multicast is planned now, with provisions to extend via MP-BGP eventually.
mentions.problem: Scaling the Bitcoin network's transaction distribution infrastructure towards billions of transactions per second.
mentions.audience: Bitcoin miners and transaction processors looking to scale transaction distribution
